# Clockitt

> Clockitt is an AI-powered goal accountability app and persistent alarm that requires photo proof verified by Claude Vision AI to silence and complete daily goals. Currently in early access with a 3-day free trial and $5/month founder rate.

## Core Entity Facts
- **Primary Function**: Persistent morning and task alarms that only silence upon AI photo proof verification.
- **Verification Engine**: Claude Vision AI (analyzes submitted task photos in real time).
- **Pricing**: $5/month early access founder rate with a 3-day free trial.
- **Accountability Modes**: Solo AI photo verification or dual-partner check-ins.
- **Platforms**: iOS, Android, Web.
- **Security & Privacy**: 256-bit SSL encrypted storage; verification photos are private and never sold or shared.

- [Accountability partner app](https://clockitt.app/accountability-partner): How Clockitt pairs you with a real person for daily goal check-ins.
